paper.title: Applications of fMRI for Brain Mapping

result.summary: 本文是一篇综述，介绍脑映射技术及 fMRI 信号处理方法 [abstract]。作者指出，正常解剖成像能提供脑部结构信息，但许多神经疾病仅靠结构研究并不足够，需要研究脑的功能组织 [abstract]。脑映射技术有助于获取这些信息，并可研究运动、感觉、言语和记忆等过程对应的脑功能与脑区 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：许多神经疾病仅靠结构成像研究并不足够，因此需要研究脑的功能组织，并研究正常与疾病状态下的脑功能 [abstract]。作者指出，脑映射技术可帮助获取这些重要信息，并研究运动、感觉、言语和记忆等过程对应的脑功能与脑区 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: However there are many neurological disorders for which only structure studies are not sufficient.
In such cases it is required to investigate the functional organization of the brain.
Further it is necessary to study the brain functions under normal as well as diseased conditions.
Brain functions and brain area responsible for the particular activities like motor, sensory speech and memory process could be investigated.

method.text: 作者提供的是对各种脑映射技术和 fMRI 信号处理方法的综述性概述 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The authors provide an overview of various Brain Mapping techniques and fMRI signal processing methods.
